interactives.label: Garden well
interactives.text: Cold water from the garden well.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: The drowned court
interactives.text: The court is swept. Someone sweeps it. What is made over it counts double, the sexton says, because the court is listening.

interactives.label: Training post
interactives.text: The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Reading
interactives.text: The cathedral's under-room. Books read three times as fast under the stone.

interactives.label: The grating
interactives.text: The grating over the drowned court was found open. The diver says from below.

interactives.label: Ferries
interactives.text: Every quay serves a route; a second berth a few tiles along the dock serves the next. Read the stone before you step on the plank.

interactives.label: Warm spring
interactives.text: The spring is warm and mineral; it restores you.

interactives.label: Butts
interactives.text: The butts list your recent combat results.

interactives.label: The crown
interactives.text: The crown was drowned on purpose. The court was drowned by accident.

interactives.label: The patina
interactives.text: Deep patina takes a century. The patina on the grating hinge is a year old.

interactives.label: The diver
interactives.text: Teth-Sa dives the court every tenth day and comes up with nothing, on purpose.

interactives.label: The Sunken Court Reliquary
interactives.text: The court's own relic room, opened with a shell from the shore.

interactives.label: Ward post
interactives.text: Nothing casts within these stones. The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Cistern
interactives.text: Rainwater from the cistern.

interactives.label: Breath
interactives.text: Rest here and the breath comes back twice as fast.

interactives.label: Regeneration
interactives.text: Sitting restores faster than standing; a spring restores faster than sitting.

sections.name: The Pearl Hollow
sections.label: A cave mouth the tide leaves open for an hour a day.
sections.note: A tide cave under the east pavilion where the pearl oysters bed.

sections.name: The Kelp Garden
sections.label: An iron drain grate, its bolts drawn.
sections.note: Kelp and reed in stone beds fed by the lake, out of the wind.

sections.name: The Customs Cache
sections.label: An iron drain grate, its bolts drawn.
sections.note: The customs officers' own cellar: a chest, a bench, and pearls not on any ledger.

sections.name: The Campanile Vault
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Under the bell tower, the sexton's strongroom.

sections.name: The Crab Pit
sections.label: A cave mouth the tide leaves open for an hour a day.
sections.note: A tide pit the fishers stock with crab for the young to learn armour on.

sections.name: The Cathedral School
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Where the sexton teaches the choir their letters.

sections.name: The Crown Spring
sections.label: A cave mouth the tide leaves open for an hour a day.
sections.note: A warm feed under the west pavilion; the lake is cold everywhere else.

sections.name: The Pavilion Butts
sections.label: An iron drain grate, its bolts drawn.
sections.note: A long gallery under the north pavilion; otters at the far end, unbothered.

sections.name: The Sunken Court Reliquary
sections.label: A shrine slab with fresh scratches where it has been slid aside.
sections.note: The court's own relic room, opened with a shell from the shore.

sections.name: The Cistern Well
sections.label: An iron drain grate, its bolts drawn.
sections.note: The cistern's stones drink every spell; the beetles do not mind.

sections.name: The Lake Focus
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: A chamber under the islet where the lake's own ether pools.

sections.name: The Crown Drain
sections.label: An iron drain grate, its bolts drawn.
sections.note: The old drain under the causeway, out under the city's west gate.

sections.name: The Crown Waystone
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Seven stones for seven ferries. An iron rune wakes them.

sections.name: The Campanile Eyrie
sections.label: An arch so grown with vine it reads as hedge.
sections.note: A pocket in the campanile's footing over the water.

secrets.note: Each section is one secret. The client shows a player only the section they stand in; the server places the arrival, the areas, the spawns and the harvest nodes from this block.

provenance.geometry: authored with the secret rooms kit over the shared toolkit

notes: 14 secrets of Crownwater Secrets on one map with void between them; which one a player gets is which feature of the ground above they used.
